releases.body:
Initial release: use your Kimi Code (Moonshot) subscription in [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) via the OAuth device flow.

- "Sign in with Kimi (subscription)" in `opencode auth login`, with automatic refresh of the short-lived access token
- Self-registers the `kimi-code` provider; models discovered live from `/models` and cached, static baseline as fallback
- Pins `temperature: 1` (required by kimi coding models); coexists with the official `kimi` CLI

Install by adding the plugin to your `opencode.json`:

```json
{ "plugin": ["opencode-kimi-subscription"] }
```

Published on npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-kimi-subscription — the attached tarball is the exact artifact published as `0.1.0`.
